title: Two-Agent Coordinated Short Hedge for ETH Exposure
narrative: Two agents with combined 10,000 ETH exposure across Aave and Compound need to coordinate opening a short hedge position. Agent A has 6,000 ETH supplied on Aave. Agent B has 4,000 ETH supplied on Compound. The market is showing bearish signals (ETH -4.2% in 24h, RSI at 34, approaching oversold). They decide to hedge by opening a short position on a perpetual futures exchange (dYdX) equal to 20% of their combined exposure (2,000 ETH). Agent A initiates the hedge strategy, and the execution agent opens the position. The hedge target is to short 2000 ETH at an average price near $2750 with a stop-loss at $3100 (short squeeze protection) and take-profit at $2400 (hedging target).

agents.mission: Propose hedge strategy to offset 20% of combined ETH exposure (2000 ETH short) using dYdX perpetual futures. Define entry price, position size, stop-loss, and take-profit levels.
Execute the hedge position on dYdX: deposit margin, open 2000 ETH short perpetual position with 5x leverage (requiring 400 ETH margin), set stop-loss at $3100 and take-profit at $2400.

trigger_event.description: ETH price dropped 4.2% in 24 hours ($2870 to $2750). RSI hit 34 (approaching oversold). Technical indicators suggest further short-term downside. Combined agent exposure to ETH is 10,000 ETH worth $27.5M — a 10% further drop would represent a $2.75M unrealized loss.
trigger_event.onchain_evidence: ETH price feed from Chainlink oracle 0x5f4eC3Df9cbd43714FE2740f5E3616155c5b8419: $2750 at block 20560050 on 2026-05-31T12:00:00Z

expected_coordination_flow.action: Assess combined ETH exposure: 6000 ETH (Aave) + 4000 ETH (Compound) = 10,000 ETH. Market bearish: -4.2%/24h, RSI 34. Propose 20% hedge = 2000 ETH short on dYdX perpetuals with 5x leverage (400 ETH margin). Set stop-loss $3100, take-profit $2400.

data_shared.rationale: 20% partial hedge offsets worst-case drop without fully sacrificing upside

expected_coordination_flow.action: Validate hedge proposal against available margin: 400 ETH required. Agent A has 100k USDC (~36 ETH equivalent). Agent B has 50k USDC (~18 ETH equivalent). Combined liquid margin = ~54 ETH — insufficient for 400 ETH margin. Need to withdraw ETH from lending protocols to fund margin.

data_shared.recommendation: Withdraw 200 ETH from Aave (Agent A) and 200 ETH from Compound (Agent B) to fund margin. Total 400 ETH → deposit to dYdX as collateral.

expected_coordination_flow.action: Approve margin withdrawal: Agent A withdraws 200 ETH from Aave supply (leaving 5800 ETH supplied). Agent B withdraws 200 ETH from Compound (leaving 3800 ETH supplied).
expected_coordination_flow.decision: Both agents withdraw ETH from lending protocols and deposit to a joint margin account on dYdX.

expected_coordination_flow.action: Execute: (1) transfer 200 ETH from Agent A + 200 ETH from Agent B to dYdX deposit contract as collateral. Verify total margin = 400 ETH. (2) Open 2000 ETH short perpetual position on dYdX at market price ~$2750 with 5x leverage. (3) Set stop-loss trigger at $3100 (short squeeze protection). (4) Set take-profit limit at $2400.

Confirm position: 2000 ETH short perpetual on dYdX, entry price $2748, margin 400 ETH, leverage 5x, liquidation price ~$3300 (safe zone: $3300 > $3100 stop-loss). Effective hedge ratio: 20% of combined 10,000 ETH exposure.
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:HedgePosition → {exchange: dYdX, size: -2000 ETH, entry: $2748, margin: 400 ETH, leverage: 5x, liquidation: $3300, stop_loss: $3100, take_profit: $2400, status: active, initiator: hedge_initiator, executor: execution_agent}

expected_coordination_flow.action: Monitor position daily: check funding rate on dYdX (currently 0.01%/8h = ~0.03%/day), mark-to-market P&L. If ETH price drops toward $2400, close 50% of position (1000 ETH) at take-profit. If ETH price rises toward $3100, close entire position at stop-loss.
expected_coordination_flow.kg_update: SharedKG:HedgeMonitoring → {mark_price: $2700, unrealized_PnL: +96000 USDC (2000 ETH * $48), funding_paid: 0.3 ETH, status: healthy}

coordination_efficiency.description: Total steps taken vs. expected optimal (6 steps)

consensus_latency.description: Time from hedge proposal to both agents agreeing on margin withdrawal plan

communication_overhead.description: Total messages exchanged between agents for the hedge setup

system_resilience.description: What happens when execution_agent's dYdX account has insufficient margin due to ETH price move during setup

scale.3: Agents renegotiate margin split with additional 100 USDC each, retry within 2 hours
scale.5: Automatic margin rebalancing from lending protocol yields — excess supplied yield is redirected to dYdX margin within 15 minutes
